kitDescription: Power is a Fire rocket-launcher Attacker whose every full-charge shot — which for an RL on auto is every shot — grants a stacking self ATK buff, Blood Fiend: +6.4% ATK per stack, up to 5 stacks, lasting 3 seconds, so she ramps to +32% within her first magazine and holds it while she keeps firing. Once per battle, after her 18th normal attack fired while Blood Fiend is at max stacks, she instantly refills her entire magazine, skipping one reload. That same trigger also widens her explosion radius for 10 seconds, which has no damage effect against a single boss. Her burst nukes the single highest-ATK enemy for 1584% of her final ATK, and if Blood Fiend is at max stacks at cast time it lands a second 1584% hit on the same target, doubling the burst.

redAssertions: 'moves no teammate' — RECON_ERROR (test premise): clearing the whole skill1 slot also removes the bloodFiend pool block that gates S2, so the one-time reload-skip dies, shot count changes (103→104, 4→5 casts), and teammate totals shift via 180s-cutoff phase. The premise 'S1 changes ATK only' is false for ANY encoding that houses the stack gate in S1; driver's per-apply targetIdx===POWER pin already proves no ally ATK leakage.

'free reload adds fire time' — RECON_ERROR (fixed-horizon phase artifact): the reload-skip is strictly ≥0 over an unbounded horizon but phase-shifts the cycle ~172f; at exactly 180s the noS2 arm lands a 5th burst cast inside the horizon while base's cast 5 (frame ~10842) misses it. 144.13−131.57 = 12.56M ≈ exactly one 3168% double nuke; the same line is net-positive (+1.05M) in the driver's 4-unit fixture.

'lands TWO burst-bucket instances per cast' — RECON_ERROR (reader bug): the blind filter keys damage events on numeric casterIdx, but damage events carry srcSlot as a string and key by slug. With e.slug==='power' the driver emits 8 burst-bucket instances vs 4 casts = exactly 2× in the blind comp (all 4 casts genuinely max-stacked there).

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA exists in the driver implementation: every kit line is either FAITHFUL with a firing, discriminating assertion or a deliberately documented gap. The raw S5 run is RED, but all three failures are blind-side artifacts, each with a quantitatively sound driver adjudication that I verified arithmetically — the 12.56M delta equals exactly one 3168% double nuke (a fixed-horizon cast-count artifact, not a sign error in the reload economy); the teammate-movement failure follows necessarily from clearing the slot that houses the gate proxy (false isolation premise, not ATK leakage — per-apply targetIdx is pinned self-only); and the burst-count failure is an event-reader field-shape bug (corrected reader gives exactly 2 instances per cast). The blind re-derivations converged on everything load-bearing, and where S6 diverged it was wrong in precisely the ways S2b pre-registered: it fell into the projectileExplosionPct radius trap, dropped the once-per-battle latch, left both max-stack gates unconditional, and added a double-counting rampSec — the driver is corroborated by prose + formula + S2b on all four. Two same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) the bloodFiend pool never decays while the real buff does at 3s — documented ⚑ tier-low with a recipe, and every in-fixture gate read lands at genuine 5 stacks, but the note's 'longest gap 172f' understates transition-stretched pauses (the blind fixture did lapse at least once), so a >3s fire pause coinciding with a cast or hit-18 is the live divergence window; (2) the driver's claim that a multi-effect chargeCounter block cycles its effects one-per-charge is asserted engine behavior not independently verified in this packet — the split-block encoding is harmless either way, but if the claim is wrong the note's rationale (not the behavior) needs correcting. Nothing must change for GO.
